plan: [This is a single-round auction, so there's no learning from past rounds. My value is $40. I need to bid strategically to maximize my profit if I win. If I bid my value, I might win but get zero profit. If I bid too low, I might lose out on a profitable win. I'll start by assuming the other bidders bid close to their values. I will bid slightly below my value, say $39.5. This gives me a chance to win with a small profit while not risking overpaying.]

I will use a bidding strategy based on my private value. Since this is a one-shot game, I don't need to worry about building a reputation or influencing future rounds. I will bid slightly below my value to try and secure a profit if I win. I'll bid 12.50. This is below my value of 13, but hopefully high enough to win.

I will start with a conservative bidding strategy, bidding slightly below my value to try and secure a profit if I win. I expect the other bidders to bid somewhat rationally, perhaps shading their bids down from their true values. If I bid too low, I risk losing out on a potentially profitable win. If I bid too high, I risk overpaying. I will bid $16.5.
